display_title: At the End of the Night, I Met You
description:
Princess Laetitia of the Kingdom of Ranstein loses a bet with her club members and receives a penalty: she must dance with a man who is not handsome at the victory celebration banquet. Just then, she discovers a man standing alone with messy hair in a corner of the banquet hall. Listening to the chatter around her, she hears his name is 'Les Kisir', that he wasn't honorable on the battlefield, and that his family and birth are also lowly. Thinking he would be perfect for the penalty, Laetitia asked him to dance, but was unexpectedly rejected. However, it was only after seeing him limp away shortly after that she realized the reason... 

Embarrassed, Laetitia hastily followed him out, found Les, and offered her apologies. At the same time, she seduced him and spent a night together, but after that, there was no contact from him. Ultimately, she starts pursuing him actively, but Les doesn't seem to yield easily...

**Original Webtoon:**   
[Lezhin](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/end_of_night), [Bomtoon](https://www.bomtoon.com/detail/end_of_night)
